# Local browser dependencies

The game loads these files locally and requires no CDN or Google Fonts requests.

- `three.module.js`: Three.js **0.151.3**, from the verified npm package `three@0.151.3`; MIT license in `THREE-LICENSE`.
- `fonts/`: Vazirmatn Arabic/Persian font subset, from `@fontsource/vazirmatn@5.2.8`; SIL Open Font License in `fonts/LICENSE`.

SHA-256 of `three.module.js`:
`95b4fa4cc9cdb0e8b1405942aaeac962b76bbb47cd275b9b9212a7813a5e34d2`.

Package downloads used npm's normal HTTPS and package integrity verification. These files are committed with the application so installation does not need Internet access.
